items.title: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
items.summary: Anthropic以每股83美元的价格完成IPO，共融资813亿美元（含最高可达1048亿美元的股本及260亿美元无投票权股票），创下历史纪录，其规模远超2012年Facebook的160亿美元。公司七位创始人各减持约340万股，每人套现约2.8亿美元，其中谷歌与亚马逊合计持有28%的股份，分别占比13.4%和14.6%。尽管募资丰厚，Anthropic未来基建承诺总额高达1.05万亿至1.08万亿美元，其中未来12个月需707亿美元用于计算基础设施，显示出巨大的资金需求。

items.summary_en: Anthropic completed its IPO on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT on November 19, 2026, opening at $111.50, which is a 33% premium over its $83 issue price and significantly above the initial $70–$78 expectation. The offering raised over $81 billion, bolstering the company’s total cash reserves to an estimated $220 billion and valuing the firm at more than $2 trillion, a market capitalization that surpasses Meta, Tesla, and Walmart.

items.summary_en: Anthropic’s Nasdaq IPO at $83 per share, valuing the company at approximately $1.4 trillion, tests AI circular financing by converting Amazon’s 14.7% and Google’s 13.7% stakes into roughly $307.9 billion in market value, a sum offset by their status as major infrastructure suppliers. The company secured $26 billion in private placement from Nvidia, AMD, Microsoft, and others alongside a $900 billion committed infrastructure spend, positioning it with $220 billion in cash and a $68 billion annualized revenue run rate to fund future operations without relying solely on supplier recoupment.

items.title: Summary-First Lost to Trimming, at 2.6x the Tokens
items.summary: 使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 本地测试发现，“摘要优先”策略（先放 5 个 issue 摘要再放全文）虽比全量文本准确率从 37.5% 提升至 66.7%，但耗时 1,724 个平均 prompt tokens，是 300 字符修剪方案（准确率 70.8%、仅 673 tokens）的 2.6 倍。该策略未能解决模型对 issue 412 的固着偏差，且因追加摘要导致 token 成本高于全量文本，无法以更高效率匹配修剪方案的精度。

items.summary_en: Perplexity Computer's "Brain" agent automatically generates and updates personal skills by analyzing historical conversation trajectories, requiring a paired replay of failure scenarios and engineer review before deployment. In an 8-week randomized production test, 72.9% of users received at least one new personal skill, resulting in an 11% reduction in tool call failure rates and a 7.6% decrease in dissatisfied conversation threads, with no measurable increase in cost or latency.

items.title: Former Alibaba exec’s Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
items.summary: Everful（由前阿里高管Song Sisi和Kevin Han联合创立）完成由Vertex Ventures领投的4850万美元A轮融资，计划年底前实现1亿美元年化收入，目前月发货量超500万件，连接3万多家中国工厂和60多个国家的零售商，并拥有超2000万款产品的在线目录。其核心差异在于利用AI代理自动化处理选品、订单合并、质控及物流的全流程外包服务，而非仅作为交易撮合平台，旨在为没有专业采购团队的中小零售商提供端到端的工厂直采体验。公司正利用新资金深化与Shopify等电商平台的集成，并拓展美国及欧洲市场，以应对中美贸易摩擦带来的政策变化，确立跨境B2B采购加本地销售的长期商业模式。
items.why_now_en: De minimis suspension shifts B2B sourcing now.
items.summary_en: Everful raised $48.5 million in Series A funding led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India and January Capital, aiming to reach $100 million in annualized revenue by year-end. The San Francisco- and Singapore-based platform connects retailers with over 30,000 Chinese factory partners, shipping 5 million monthly items to 60+ countries through an AI-enabled, end-to-end sourcing process that handles logistics and quality control. Co-founded by former Alibaba executive Sisi Song and Amazon seller Kevin Han, the company is expanding into the U.S., U.K., France, and Italy to integrate e-commerce workflows while navigating U.S.-China trade policy shifts.

The company opened trading at $111.50, a 33% premium to the IPO price, placing its market cap above $2 trillion—ranking it fifth in value behind Apple, Amazon, Alphabet, Nvidia, and Microsoft. CEO Dario Amodei framed the financial milestone as a commitment to safety, aiming to demonstrate that prioritizing responsible AI development remains commercially viable.

items.summary_en: Nvidia launched the RTX Spark Compact Desktop starting at $4,399, featuring the N1X chip that integrates a 20-core CPU with a 6144-core GPU and 128GB unified memory to achieve 1 Petaflop FP4 performance. Local execution of models like Qwen 3.8 reduces monthly inference costs for high-volume workloads from $1,200 in cloud API fees to just $20 in electricity, matching the intelligence benchmarks of cloud models like Claude Sonnet 5.5. The system supports running 120B-parameter models with 1 million token contexts and features PAIR technology that distributes AI tasks across existing MacBooks and gaming PCs, while also supporting updated DLSS 5 graphics features.

items.title: Audit a Claude Code skill before you install it: 4 checks I run every time
items.why_now: Claude Code 2.1+ 新增插件安装功能，社区技能生态安全审查需求凸显。
items.summary_en: Before installing a Claude Code skill, run a 30-second audit checking four factors: whether the YAML frontmatter description accurately defines the activation trigger, if the directory contains only Markdown or executable scripts that require review, whether the toolset used is read-only or explicitly respects authorization boundaries, and if the skill mandates verifying real code evidence rather than generating plausible guesses. Using the laolaoshiren/claude-code-skills-zh collection as examples, skills like zh-code-reviewer, zh-readme, and api-tester pass these checks by avoiding bundled executables and defining clear output constraints. Validated skills can be installed via Claude Code 2.1+ using the `/plugin marketplace` and `/plugin install` commands, or manually by cloning the repository and copying the skill files to `~/.claude/skills`.

items.title: Real-Estate Listing Retrieval Architecture: Ranking Signals That Keep Citations Honest
items.summary: 针对房地产房源检索架构，核心设计采用Web搜索与向量检索混合模式，利用Web路径确保数据新鲜度和来源可追溯，通过向量路径实现可控的语义匹配与删除策略。方案强调建立严格的检索契约，要求返回结果必须包含当前状态、更新时间戳及源页面引用，以防止过期房源或错误信息被高相似度分数掩盖。推荐采用Infrai作为适配器层，通过统一的REST API集成Web与向量检索，同时保留排名策略和引用验证逻辑在业务代码中，确保系统可替换性与准确性。
items.why_now: 文章缺乏具体时效信号，输出
items.summary_en: The article defines a retrieval architecture for real-estate listing discovery that mandates an explicit answer contract requiring five active listings with cited sources and verified status. It proposes a two-stage ranking system combining live web search for freshness and vector query for semantic control, using deterministic filters to prevent stale or deleted properties from overriding similarity scores. To implement this, developers are advised to use an adapter layer like Infrai to normalize API responses and keep ranking policies in application code, ensuring that update or delete events are processed to maintain citation integrity.

items.title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
items.summary: HKUDS/CLI-Anything 项目通过统一的命令行接口将软件转化为 Agent-Native 形态，支持 Cursor、Claude Code 等主流 AI 工具，并可通过 CLI-Hub 一键安装管理社区贡献的 CAD、Obsidian、n8n 等软件 CLI。该项目近期实现了安全加固（如 Sketch 路径遍历防护、XML 解析引入 defusedxml）及注册表自动化优化，同时合并了 Rekordbox、Calibre、3MF 和 MiniMax 等核心 CLI 支持，并统一了顶层 skills/ 目录以简化技能安装流程。
items.why_now: 新API刚上线，CLI-Hub已支持一键安装管理社区CLI，抢占Agent原生软件生态窗口期。
items.summary_en: CLI-Anything by HKUDS converts arbitrary software into agent-native CLIs, enabling AI agents like Pi, Cursor, and Claude Code to operate applications via the `cli-anything-hub` Python package and community registry. The framework supports diverse workflows—including CAD, 3D scene generation, and media processing—through generated CLI harnesses with specialized skills, such as Obsidian automation with persistent memory and Sketch security-hardened interfaces. Recent updates unify skill documentation under a canonical directory structure and integrate MCP-compatible extensions for Unreal Editor and ArcGIS Pro to expand the ecosystem's compatibility with agentic development environments.

items.title: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator
items.summary: NVIDIA 推出的 SkillEvaluator 是一个针对 AI 智能体技能与插件的多层评估框架，包含 500+ 静态规则，能执行质量门控、安全扫描、语义重叠检测及实智能体行为影响测量。用户可通过 `pip install skillevaluator` 快速集成，利用 CI 模板在合并前自动捕获问题，并通过 Harness 检查验证该技能是否兼容 Claude Code、Codex 等主流智能体环境。
items.why_now: NVIDIA SkillEvaluator 刚上线 CI 模板，开发者可直接集成自动质量门禁。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA SkillEvaluator is a multi-tier CLI framework that validates AI agent skills through 500+ static rules, security scanning via SkillSpector and Gitleaks, and harness compatibility checks across six agents, offering a keyless baseline quality score with a 70-point passing threshold. It enables live agent evaluation to measure performance lift by comparing task runs with and without a skill, using free NVIDIA Build endpoints for users enrolled in the Developer Program. The tool integrates directly into GitHub and GitLab workflows through reusable CI templates, automating pre-merge gates without requiring teams to maintain custom evaluation code.

items.title: google-research/paper-orchestra
items.summary: Google Research 发布的多智能体框架 PaperOrchestra 能够自动将非结构化的研究想法和实验日志转化为符合目标会议模板（如 CVPR 2025）的提交级 LaTeX 论文。该框架通过协同编排大纲生成、文献综述、分节写作、内容精炼及绘图等专用代理，实现了从原始素材到成稿的端到端自动化，并支持自动搜索整合相关文献及生成图表。用户需在 Python 3.11 环境中配置 Semantic Scholar、OpenAI 或 Gemini 等 API 密钥，并通过指定原始材料目录和 LaTeX 模板目录的参数化 CLI 命令即可运行生成流水线。
items.why_now: 谷歌开源PaperOrchestra，即刻可用多智能体将科研草稿转为LaTeX论文。
items.summary_en: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework from Google Cloud AI Research that transforms raw research materials into submission-ready LaTeX manuscripts by orchestrating specialized agents for outline generation, literature synthesis, and visual plotting. The system integrates with LLMs like Gemini and OpenAI to automatically search and integrate relevant literature while generating plots and conceptual diagrams, ensuring adherence to specific conference templates. Developers can deploy the Python 3.11-based tool via command-line or an interactive Streamlit demo, though the associated dataset remains pending separate release.

items.title: These tech outages are giving Y2K, AI agent style
items.summary: 过去两周内，美国多家核心基础设施相继发生故障，包括Apple Pay宕机、NASA内部网络中断、FAA停飞数小时（9/11以来第三次），以及微软Outlook、Teams和Copilot服务因故障离线近两天。虽然官方初步排除网络攻击，但专家推测这些并发故障源于AI工具（如Mythos）加速暴露系统漏洞，迫使企业紧急修补，导致旧硬件无法承受现代技术迁移压力。这反映了AI在重塑软件运维时，因遗留系统与新技术混合过渡期缺乏风险管控而产生的阵痛，并非直接的AI黑客入侵。
items.why_now_en: Legacy system outages signal urgent need for AI-adjacent patching tools.
items.summary_en: Recent major outages at Microsoft (disrupting Outlook, Teams, and Copilot for nearly two days) and the FAA (grounding all flights for hours) are driven by rapid legacy-to-modern system migrations rather than cyberattacks or AI. Experts attribute the failures to the unstable integration of outdated industrial hardware with modern, high-capacity technologies, exacerbated by the accelerated discovery of vulnerabilities by AI tools like Mythos. This convergence of rushed modernization and AI-surfaced flaws has created widespread operational disruptions, prompting a call for more rigorous testing and risk management in AI adoption.

items.title: 好清晰！最新国产AI画的8K图，放这么大大大大也不糊！
items.summary_en: Kling Image 4.0 is a new domestic AI image model featuring a native unified architecture that combines world knowledge and visual perception in a single Transformer, enabling the generation of stable, high-resolution 8K images. It supports up to 2,000 characters with 70+ font styles in single images, creates coherent sets of up to 10 sequential images, and handles long-form content like e-commerce detail pages and storyboards. The model processes instructions up to 15,000 tokens using structured visual language and introduces agentic capabilities for complex task planning, allowing for precise control over multi-object scenes and artistic styles.

items.title: 腾讯混元 Hy4 正式开源并发布 System Card

items.summary_en: Tencent Hunyuan officially open-sourced the Hy4 model and released its safety evaluation System Card, making it available for deployment on GitHub, Hugging Face, ModelScope, and GitCode. The company has now fully open-sourced its entire Hunyuan LLM lineup, including Hy3 preview, Hy3, Hy4 preview, Hy4, and Hy4 flash, with a commitment to continuous iteration and future open-source releases.

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.summary_en: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO following revelations that his extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy, Alice Huang of Megaspeed, jeopardized U.S. national security amid the firm’s $4.8 billion chip sales to the Singapore-based entity. The company has since suspended sales of H200 chips to China, closing a critical export loophole, and reported quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion—a 103% year-over-year increase—while interim CEO Colette Kress confirmed the board will not reinstate Huang.

items.title: 彭博社：黄仁勋离任英伟达 CEO 后日本 AI 股首当其冲
items.summary: 彭博社报道指出，黄仁勋离任英伟达 CEO 引发日本 AI 股抛售，铠侠和爱德万测试股价累计下跌超 9%，跑输东证指数约 2.9% 的跌幅。尽管日本市场风向从“AI 溢价”转向“AI 折价”，但美国六大科技公司今年资本支出预计达 8,850 亿美元，明年或增至 1.45 万亿美元，显示 AI 基础设施需求尚未出现明确拐点。
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang’s abrupt departure as Nvidia CEO has triggered a selloff in global AI stocks, with Japanese firms like Kioxia and Advantest falling over 9% as market sentiment shifts from an "AI premium" to an "AI discount." This decline is driven by a "triple hit" of concerns over AI profitability, stricter US regulatory expectations, and industry confidence shock, even though six major US tech giants are projected to increase capital expenditure by 64% to $1.45 trillion next year.

items.title: 浮屏：截图即可「上岛」，还能帮你记录生活
items.summary: 浮屏（Floato）是一款由个人开发者打造的 iOS 应用，通过 AI 分析截图自动提取取餐码、车票等关键信息，生成卡片并同步至锁屏及灵动岛，实现跨 App 的统一信息管理。该应用支持通过截图分享或快捷指令导入，利用路由拆分与流式解析优化识别效率，并将完成的截图转化为日历形式的“回顾”页面以记录生活轨迹。目前已上架美区 App Store，定价为月费 1.99 美元，新用户可免费体验 10 次识别。
items.summary_en: Floato is a solo-developed iOS app that uses AI to analyze screenshots of digital tickets and codes, automatically generating formatted cards for the lock screen and Dynamic Island across supported categories like train tickets, movie passes, and subscription services. To balance accuracy and speed, the developer implemented prompt caching, route splitting, and a fast decision model, aiming to complete image parsing within 10 seconds, while noting that screenshots are processed by external servers. The app is currently available on the US App Store at $1.99, $3.99, or $7.99 per month, quarter, or year, respectively, and offers a "Review" page that aggregates finished cards into a calendar-based life log.

items.title: Meta’s new Muse Charm device may cost $300
items.summary: Meta 即将推出售价 300 美元的 AI 硬件设备 Muse Charm，该设备集成了 Muse 智能助手，允许用户通过实体设备与 AI 对话、提问及下达指令。作为 Meta 进军消费级 AI 硬件的举措，其定价高于 Friend 公司售价 250 美元的 AI 伴侣设备，但远高于 Amazon 售价 75 美元且订阅费 99 美元/年的 Bee Frontier 设备。
items.summary_en: Meta’s upcoming Tamagotchi-like AI wearable, Muse Charm, is expected to cost $300 and features a physical avatar for Meta’s Muse agentic assistant. This price point significantly exceeds competitors like Friend’s $250 wearable and Amazon’s Bee Frontier device, which retails for $75 (currently $52.49 on sale) despite a $99/year subscription requirement.

items.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and could be exposing private data, report says
items.summary: Meta旗下AI智能体Muse被曝存在跨账户混淆对话及泄露隐私数据的严重漏洞，员工在测试中收到未请求的育儿信息、不属于自己的银行账户余额（如Capital One $2722.58和Charles Schwab $5899.57）以及来自Signal应用的未授权消息提醒。尽管Muse自9月推出以来已创下历史最快增长纪录，拥有超1000万下载量，但内部测试表明其仍缺乏足够的安全与隐私保护机制，导致私人数据在非授权场景中意外暴露。
items.summary_en: Meta’s AI agent Muse, launched in September and boasting over 10 million downloads, has been flagged by internal employees for critical privacy failures, including cross-account data leakage and unauthorized access to third-party apps. Specific incidents reveal the agent surfacing unrelated user details, such as displaying Capital One and Charles Schwab bank balances for incorrect users and sending reminders for Signal messages without explicit permission. Meta responds that these issues stem from employees testing unreleased features intended to identify and implement necessary safety and privacy protections.

items.title: Fuck Your AI Safeguards
items.summary: Anthropic的Claude Code因执行严格的安全防护措施而拒绝协助修复简单的安全漏洞，迫使开发者提交耗时数天且需身份验证的豁免申请，而犯罪分子则可直接利用无限制模型实施攻击。开发者最终使用EU托管的开源模型GLM 5.3成功证明并修复了该安全漏洞，彻底规避了商业模型的合规障碍。
